parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of a display, primarily made of glass with a rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, serving as the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed to the base and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic, providing support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and maintains the display’s upright position on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base may allow limited rotation or tilt adjustment of the screen but is otherwise stationary.
